seoTitle: How to Use Nectar Points on eBay Under the New Rules
metaDescription: Nectar and eBay no longer connect at checkout. Here's how points work now: shopping through nectar.com, the current earn rate, exclusions, and what happened to points you already had.
intro:
Nectar and eBay used to work as a linked account: connect the two once, and points appeared automatically every time you checked out on eBay. That stopped on 1 September 2024. eBay's own help page states plainly that customers are "no longer able to collect and spend Nectar points on eBay purchases" through the marketplace itself.

The partnership didn't end, though, it moved. Nectar still runs a dedicated eBay page, but it now works like a click-through shopping portal: you start your trip at nectar.com or in the Nectar app, follow the link to eBay from there, and points land in your Nectar account rather than applying at eBay's own checkout. This guide covers how that works now, the current rate, what's excluded, and what happened to points earned before the cutoff.
prerequisites: A Nectar account, existing or new (you can join during the process)
An eBay account, since points are earned on purchases made there, just not through eBay's own checkout

steps.heading: Know what changed on 1 September 2024
steps.body:
Before that date, linking your Nectar and eBay accounts was enough on its own: points built up automatically every time you checked out on eBay, and you could spend them there too. eBay's help centre now states that direct earning and spending stopped on 1 September 2024, so points no longer accrue simply because the two accounts are linked.

The eBay partnership still exists on Nectar's side. It's just treated as a shopping destination now, the same way Nectar treats any other retailer in its points scheme, and that's where earning happens.

image.caption: Nectar's eBay page, now working as a click-through shopping destination rather than a linked-checkout partner.

steps.heading: Start your shop at Nectar, not at eBay
steps.body: Go to Nectar's eBay page at nectar.com, or open the eBay listing inside the Nectar app, and click through from there before you start browsing. Nectar's terms are specific about this: points are awarded only on purchases completed online "on the retailer's site, only when accessed exclusively from the Website." Opening eBay directly, or clicking away to another site or an ad banner partway through your shop, can break the tracking and cost you the points on that order.

steps.heading: Sign in or join Nectar first
steps.body: If you don't already have a Nectar account, the eBay page offers a join option next to sign-in for existing members. Either way, be signed in to Nectar, in the same browser, before you click through to eBay. The account that earns the points is whichever one you're logged into at the moment of the click-through, not something configured once and forgotten.

steps.heading: Check the current rate and what's excluded
steps.body: Nectar's eBay page lists the standard rate as usually 2 points per £1, with occasional short-term bonus offers on top; a 4-points-per-£1 promotion has run as a time-limited deal. Points are not awarded on delivery and postage costs, gift cards, purchases made with a discount or voucher code, or VAT and other taxes. There are upper limits too: Nectar caps qualifying purchases at £13,500, with lower caps in the Business & Industrial and Motors categories, and it excludes some categories outright, including gold bars or coins and charity or non-profit listings. Points typically take 45 to 90 days to land in your account after a qualifying purchase.

steps.heading: Spending points now goes through Nectar, not eBay checkout
steps.body: There's no option to redeem Nectar points during eBay checkout any more. If you converted points into an eBay voucher before the 1 September 2024 cutoff, eBay confirms that voucher stays valid for one year from the day it was created. After that, spending happens through Nectar's own reward catalogue instead of eBay directly.

troubleshooting.problem: Points don't show up after an eBay purchase
troubleshooting.cause: The purchase wasn't started from Nectar's site or app, or the browser session broke. Closing tabs, using an ad blocker, or visiting another site partway through can all stop the click-through from being tracked.
troubleshooting.fix: Start the shop again from Nectar's eBay page, complete the purchase in the same tab, and allow 45 to 90 days for points to post before contacting support.

troubleshooting.problem: The points earned are lower than expected
troubleshooting.cause: Nectar calculates points on the item price only. VAT, delivery, gift cards, and discount-code purchases are all excluded from that base.
troubleshooting.fix: Check the order's item-price line against Nectar's exclusion list, not the checkout total.

troubleshooting.problem: No option to spend points at eBay checkout
troubleshooting.cause: Direct redemption at eBay ended on 1 September 2024. Only vouchers converted before that date still work, and only for one year from creation.
troubleshooting.fix: Redeem through Nectar's own reward catalogue instead of looking for a checkout option on eBay.

faq.question: Can I still link my Nectar account so points earn automatically at eBay checkout?
faq.answer: No. That stopped on 1 September 2024. Points now come from starting your shop at Nectar's eBay page or in the Nectar app and clicking through to eBay from there, not from having the two accounts linked.

faq.question: How do I earn Nectar points shopping at eBay now?
faq.answer: Sign in to Nectar first, then click through to eBay from Nectar's eBay page or the Nectar app rather than opening eBay directly. The purchase needs to be completed in that same browsing session.

faq.question: What's the current Nectar earning rate at eBay?
faq.answer: Usually 2 points per £1, with occasional short-term bonus offers, such as 4 points per £1, appearing on Nectar's eBay page.

faq.question: What purchases don't earn points?
faq.answer: Delivery costs, gift cards, discount- or voucher-code purchases, VAT, and a handful of excluded categories including gold bars or coins and charity listings. There are also value caps of £13,500 generally, lower in Business & Industrial and Motors.

faq.question: Can I spend Nectar points during eBay checkout?
faq.answer: No, not any more. Redemption now happens through Nectar's own reward catalogue. The one exception is a voucher converted before 1 September 2024, which stays valid for one year from when it was created.

faq.question: What happened to Nectar points or vouchers I already had?
faq.answer: Existing Nectar balances are still accessible through your Nectar account. A voucher converted before the September 2024 change remains usable on eBay for one year from its creation date.

verifiedNote: The previous version of this guide described Nectar and eBay as linked accounts earning points automatically at eBay checkout. Re-checked against eBay's official help page and Nectar's own eBay page in September 2026: that mechanism ended on 1 September 2024. This version reflects the current click-through earning model, the current rate and exclusions, and the one-year validity window on vouchers converted before the cutoff.
